name: Enter a GitHub release
description: Recording a release as a testing version. Two statements, not one: db_write returns only rows_affected, so the row is read back, and both statements join live_sessions -- a revoked session must neither write nor read, and the read-back alone deciding 201 would fail open. The insert carries the open season's rules as PREDICATES, so a refusal is a row that was never written rather than a check that could be raced; zero rows then sends `why` to read the state back and `refused` answers 409 with one word. The duplicate refusal deliberately does not name the version it collided with: unique_weights excludes the caller, so the row it matched is always another competitor's, and naming or dating it would report one competitor's submission to another.

tasks.name: Both hashes, declared and well formed
tasks.description: `sha256:` and 71 characters, which is the shape and not the alphabet -- datalogic has no regex operator. The alphabet is checked where it matters: axon derives the object-store key from the hash and refuses anything that is not 64 hex digits, which is what stops a hash from being a path.

logic.detail: weights_hash and adapter_hash are required, each as sha256:<64 hex>. Run `sha256sum model.onnx adapter.json` on the files you attached to the release.

input.query: INSERT INTO model_versions (model_id, game_id, season_id, version, release_tag, weights_hash, adapter_hash) SELECT e.id, g.id, s.id, coalesce(max(v.version), 0) + 1, ($4)::text, ($6)::text, ($7)::text FROM games g JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.submissions_open_at <= now() AND now() < s.submissions_close_at JOIN models e ON e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND e.retired_at IS NULL AND (e.id::text = ($3)::text OR lower(e.repo) = lower(repo_path(($3)::text))) JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.sid = ($5)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid LEFT JOIN model_versions v ON v.model_id = e.id WHERE g.slug = ($2)::text AND season_admits(s, ($1)::uuid) AND season_admits_weights(s, ($1)::uuid, ($6)::text, e.id) AND season_admits_in_flight(s, ($1)::uuid) AND season_admits_version(s, ($1)::uuid, e.id) AND season_admits_cooldown(s, e.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_versions f WHERE f.model_id = e.id AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')) GROUP BY e.id, g.id, s.id

SELECT json_build_object( 'season', s.number, 'state', CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN season_state(s) END, 'submissions_open_at', s.submissions_open_at, 'submissions_close_at', s.submissions_close_at, 'model', (SELECT json_build_object('model_id', e.id, 'model', e.name, 'repo', e.repo, 'retired', e.retired_at IS NOT NULL) FROM models e WHERE e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND (e.id::text = ($4)::text OR lower(e.repo) = lower(repo_path(($4)::text)))), 'participant', s.id IS NULL OR season_admits(s, ($2)::uuid), 'in_flight', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('version_id', f.id, 'model_id', f.model_id, 'model', fe.name, 'version', f.version, 'phase', model_phase(f)) ORDER BY fe.name) FROM model_versions f JOIN models fe ON fe.id = f.model_id WHERE fe.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND fe.game_id = g.id AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')), '[]'::json), 'entry_in_flight', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_versions f JOIN models fe ON fe.id = f.model_id WHERE fe.game_id = g.id AND fe.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND (fe.id::text = ($4)::text OR lower(fe.repo) = lower(repo_path(($4)::text))) AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')), 'in_flight_ok', s.id IS NULL OR season_admits_in_flight(s, ($2)::uuid), 'versions_ok', s.id IS NULL OR (SELECT season_admits_version(s, ($2)::uuid, e.id) FROM models e WHERE e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND (e.id::text = ($4)::text OR lower(e.repo) = lower(repo_path(($4)::text)))), 'cooldown_until', (SELECT season_cooldown_until(s, e.id) FROM models e WHERE e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND (e.id::text = ($4)::text OR lower(e.repo) = lower(repo_path(($4)::text)))), 'unique_weights_scope', coalesce(s.rules -> 'unique_weights' ->> 'scope', 'game'), 'unique_weights', s.id IS NULL OR (SELECT season_admits_weights(s, ($2)::uuid, ($3)::text, e.id) FROM models e WHERE e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND (e.id::text = ($4)::text OR lower(e.repo) = lower(repo_path(($4)::text))))) AS body FROM games g LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text

tasks.name: No such model
tasks.description: A submission names a model the caller does not own, or does not have: 404 and not 409, because nothing about the season refused it. Entries are created explicitly -- a repository with no entry behind it is not silently adopted, or a typo in a repo path would quietly start a second lineage with its own version numbers.

tasks.name: Refused by the season
tasks.description: Every refusal is the negation of a predicate the INSERT carried, read back through the same season_admits_* function -- asked twice, answered the same, or a competitor is refused for a reason the response denies. `cooling_down` is the one exception and is reported as an instant rather than a boolean, because it is a function of now(): the insert and this read are a moment apart and at the boundary they genuinely differ, so the page says "try again at 14:02" instead of a verdict it cannot reproduce. A revoked session also inserts nothing and is not this task's: with the season open and every rule satisfied it falls through to the read-back, whose empty result `deny` answers 401.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('version_id', v.id, 'model_id', e.id, 'model', e.name, 'repo', e.repo, 'version', v.version, 'status', v.status, 'season', se.number, 'weights_hash', v.weights_hash, 'adapter_hash', v.adapter_hash) AS body FROM model_versions v JOIN models e ON e.id = v.model_id JOIN games g ON g.id = e.game_id JOIN seasons se ON se.id = v.season_id AND se.closed_at IS NULL JOIN live_sessions s ON s.sid = ($4)::uuid AND s.user_id = e.owner_id WHERE e.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND g.slug = ($2)::text AND (e.id::text = ($3)::text OR lower(e.repo) = lower(repo_path(($3)::text))) AND v.release_tag = ($5)::text
